item.title: Cavs vs. Magic: preview, odds, injury report, TV
item.description: Orlando will try to turn this into a 48-minute grind, the kind of game that tests discipline as much as talent. Cleveland’s challenge is to meet that physicality without losing its structure.

item.title: Should high school athletes cash in on their fame with NIL? Ohio can’t decide
item.description: Two competing Ohio House bills — one banning name, image and likeness licensing for high schoolers, one allowing it — expose a growing philosophical divide over money, youth sports, and what childhood should mean.

item.title: Brunswick Hills Trustees continue search for new fire chief
item.description: Brunswick Hills Township trustees continued the fire chief search discussion at their March 11 meeting. A presentation by a private personnel search firm was scheduled for the board’s March 25 meeting.

item.title: Did one pitch in the 9th inning just blow up the Guardians’ entire opening day roster?
item.description: Austin Hedges left Monday's exhibition game immediately after being hit on the hand, throwing Cleveland's carefully constructed 26-man roster into last-minute chaos just days before the Seattle opener.

item.title: North Royalton council rejects plan for assisted living center at West 130th &amp;amp; Bennett

item.title: Is Chase DeLauter the power-hitting outfielder the Guardians have been waiting 10 years to find?
item.description: Chase DeLauter's 448-foot blast, a .459 spring average, and a 1.373 OPS have Cleveland's former top draft pick firmly in the American League Rookie of the Year conversation before a single regular season pitch is thrown.

item.title: New paths, safer streets: Lorain County’s big push to get you moving in 2026
